lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so chhootai mahaa jaal te jis gurasabad nira(n)tar ||2||
lines.translation: They escape from the great noose of death; they are permeated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਤ ਸਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee mahimaa kiaa kahaa gur bibek sat sar ||
lines.translation: How can I chant the Glorious Praises of the Guru? The Guru is the ocean of Truth and clear understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ohu aad jugaadee jugah jug pooraa paramesar ||3||
lines.translation: He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaavahu sad sadaa har har man ra(n)ge ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, my mind is filled with the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦੪॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu praan dhan guroo hai naanak kai sa(n)ge ||4||2||104||
lines.translation: The Guru is my soul, my breath of life, and wealth; O Nanak, He is with me forever. ||4||2||104||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਭੋਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saaee alakh apaar bhoree man vasai ||
lines.translation: If the Invisible and Infinite Lord dwells within my mind, even for a moment,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇ ਮੈਡਾ ਹਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dookh darad rog maai maidaa habh nasai ||1||
lines.translation: then all my pains, troubles, and diseases vanish. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵੰਞਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਾਈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau va(n)njaa kurabaan saaee aapane ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Lord Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hovai anad ghanaa man tan jaapane ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditating on Him, a great joy wells up within my mind and body. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦਕ ਗਾਲੑਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bi(n)dak gaalhi sunee sache tis dhanee ||
lines.translation: I have heard only a little bit of news about the True Lord Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਇ ਨ ਕੀਮ ਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sookhee hoo(n) sukh paai maai na keem ganee ||2||
lines.translation: I have obtained the peace of all peace, O my mother; I cannot estimate its worth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਣ ਪਸੰਦੋ ਸੋਇ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੁਸਤਾਕ ਭਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nain pasa(n)do soi pekh musataak bhaee ||
lines.translation: He is so beautiful to my eyes; beholding Him, I have been bewitched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mai niragun meree maai aap laR laai laee ||3||
lines.translation: I am worthless, O my mother; He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹਭਾ ਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed kateb sa(n)saar habhaa hoo(n) baaharaa ||
lines.translation: He is beyond the world of the Vedas, the Koran and the Bible.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa paatisaahu disai jaaharaa ||4||3||105||
lines.translation: The Supreme King of Nanak is immanent and manifest. ||4||3||105||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਖ ਭਗਤ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਪੀਉ ਪੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: laakh bhagat aaraadhahi japate peeu peeu ||
lines.translation: Tens of thousands of devotees worship and adore You, chanting, "Beloved, Beloved."

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਉ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kavan jugat melaavau niragun bikhaee jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: How shall You unite me, the worthless and corrupt soul, with Yourself. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree tek govi(n)d gupaal daiaal prabh ||
lines.translation: You are my Support, O Merciful God, Lord of the Universe, Sustainer of the World.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) sabhanaa ke naath teree srisat sabh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are the Master of all; the entire creation is Yours. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sahaaee sa(n)t pekhahi sadaa hajoor ||
lines.translation: You are the constant help and support of the Saints, who behold You Ever-present.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੜਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਰਨੑਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam bihoonaRiaa se maranhi visoor visoor ||2||
lines.translation: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall die, engulfed in sorrow and pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਤਣ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗਉਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: daas daasatan bhaai mitiaa tinaa gaun ||
lines.translation: Those servants, who lovingly perform the Lord's service, are freed from the cycle of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾੜਾ ਹਾਲੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: visariaa jinhaa naam tinaaRaa haal kaun ||3||
lines.translation: What shall be the fate of those who forget the Naam? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਹਰੑਿਆਉ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise pas harhiaau taisaa sa(n)saar sabh ||
lines.translation: As are the cattle which have strayed, so is the entire world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ba(n)dhan kaat milaavahu aap prabh ||4||4||106||
lines.translation: O God, please cut away Nanak's bonds, and unite him with Yourself. ||4||4||106||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਹਿਕੋ ਖਿਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: habhe thok visaar hiko khiaal kar ||
lines.translation: Forget all other things, and dwell upon the Lord alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਲਾਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothaa laahi gumaan man tan arap dhar ||1||
lines.translation: Lay aside your false pride, and dedicate your mind and body to Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ਤੂੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar saalaahi sirajanahaar too(n) ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, praise the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevaa(n) teree daat kirapaa karahu moo(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I live by Your bountiful gifts - please, shower me with Your Mercy! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee ka(n)m kamaai jit mukh ujalaa ||
lines.translation: So, do that work, by which your face shall be made radiant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਲਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: soee lagai sach jis too(n) dehi alaa ||2||
lines.translation: He alone becomes attached to the Truth, O Lord, unto whom You give it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨ ਢਹੰਦੋ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo na dhaha(n)do mool so ghar raas kar ||
lines.translation: So build and adorn that house, which shall never be destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: hiko chit vasaai kade na jaai mar ||3||
lines.translation: Enshrine the One Lord within your consciousness; He shall never die. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinhaa piaaraa raam jo prabh bhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is dear to those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੦੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad akath naanak vakhaaniaa ||4||5||107||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, Nanak describes the indescribable. ||4||5||107||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇ ਕਿਨੇਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhaa na visarai naam se kinehiaa ||
lines.translation: What are they like - those who do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhed na jaanahu mool saa(n)ee jehiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Know that there is absolutely no difference; they are exactly like the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan hoi nihaal tumh sa(n)g bhetiaa ||
lines.translation: The mind and body are enraptured, meeting with You, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh paaiaa jan parasaad dukh sabh metiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Peace is obtained, by the favor of the Lord's humble servant; all pains are taken away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਤਿੰਨੑ ਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jete kha(n)d brahama(n)d udhaare ti(n)nh khe ||
lines.translation: As many as are the continents of the world, so many have been saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jinh man vuthaa aap poore bhagat se ||2||
lines.translation: Those, in whose minds You Yourself dwell, O Lord, are the perfect devotees. ||2||
